acknowledgments.reason: The revised plan intentionally requires the operator-run, permanently snapshotted A2 migration before importing or link-replacing any substantive legacy tree. Reverting to automatic startup cutover would weaken the customization-first and reversible-migration invariants.

Read-only inventory may hash live sources only for preview. It authorizes no mutation; apply must prove container absence, create and verify the permanent snapshot, and rehash every source before cutover, aborting on any mismatch.
